items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Erwin Leclerc came in there and he knew me and I knew him

ctx.x: Did you hear him? Erwin Leclerc?

I can't say that I ever remember hearing Erwin play, but I can tell you a funny story about Erwin. Erwin wrote quite a bit of nice tunes. I knew one tune called It's Too Late to Be Sorry. He wrote it with Joe Huertas. I don't think anybody ever played it. Erwin Leclerc. Erwin Leclerc. Erwin Leclerc. Erwin Leclerc. Erwin Leclerc came in there and he knew me and I knew him, but he didn't know that I knew this tune and I started playing it for him. And you should have seen the expression on his face. items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: I guess I haven't seen him in years.

ctx.x: Yeah. Of course he probably didn't need the music.
What's Allman doing these days? He's working at the Royal Orleans. Oh, that's fine. I guess I haven't seen him in years. You know this now?
